note: Synthetic users for the MOKA concept site. Each persona browses the live site with Playwright (look.mjs) and writes a JSON report (schema below). AI personas are a heuristic, not real people: they find missing information, unclear copy, navigation dead ends and design issues; they cannot feel real-device smoothness.

tasks.steps: how they got there or where they got stuck

quotes: 2-4 short first-person reactions in the persona's own language
